text_block_list.text:
Whew. It's finally the last day of summer
camp...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Heh... My engines were operating at full

capacity...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
So I'm just gonna... close my eyes... on
the bus
home...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: I'll wake up... when we get there...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I let her get some good rest on the bus
this year
too.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Heehee, I slept like a log on the bus! I
think I can
do some extra training now...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
choice_data_list: You still seem pretty sleepy to me.

text_block_list.text: Yeah... I think so too, but...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
She was really twinkly—so bright I had
to squint.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: I really wanna train now. Can we?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
After rubbing her eyes a few times, she
runs off to
the training center.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
